_doc: TENANT-REPO-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-22: "This is an app, a tenant, so it needs its own repo."): every tenant app lives in its own repository of the org; this repository keeps only its manifest (IDEA.md, instance.json, lifecycle.json, runway.json, README pointer). Read by foundation/tenantrepos.py (--check in checks) and by .github/workflows/tenant-repos.yml, which creates a missing repository from the tenant's folder with its history. The tenant's Worker is deployed by deploy-ultrastable, which builds it from the tenant repository named as `source` in doctrine/topology.json. TENANT-SANDBOX-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25: "All UltraStable deployments shall have their own GitHub repo and shall be sandboxed as tenant apps."): every tenant with a worker carries `sandbox` (its own stores named ultrastable-<slug>*, its own secret names, a daily budget whose D1 part is sampled by the tick through instances/ultrastable/cost-budgets.json); `tenantrepos --isolation` is the probe. States planned (manifest only; its repository is created before its first code, by the same workflow) and retired (no live deployment).

# Unlearn: agent instructions

> Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.

Unlearn is a tenant system on Ultrastable. This repository holds its code: the evidence encyclopedia and its loops (`worker/`), the coaching
tool's phases (`phases.json`), and core files it reads, vendored under `vendor/ultrastable/`. Its manifest (IDEA.md, instance.json,
lifecycle.json, runway.json) and the platform rules every agent follows live in the core repository, `ultrastable/ultrastable`
(`agents/AGENTS.md`, `instances/unlearn/`, `doctrine/tenant-repos.json`).

- Test: `node --test worker/*.test.mjs` (CI runs it on every pull request).
- Deploy: the platform builds this repository's `main` into the `ultrastable-unlearn` Worker (D1 `ultrastable-unlearn`, Workers AI, hourly
  cron, `unlearn.ultrastable.org`). Nothing here holds a credential.
- Honest grading: nothing publishes on an unverified citation; a model may only label or re-word, never add a number, a name or a source.
- No child accounts and no child data; no cookies; reader taps are anonymous counts.

# Replication Ledger: agent instructions

> Ultrastable is the foundation for any autonomous system.

The Replication Ledger is a tenant system on Ultrastable: which landmark findings held up when replicated and which failed, across many fields. This repository holds its code (`worker/`) and its data (`worker/data/findings.json`). Its manifest (IDEA.md, instance.json, lifecycle.json, runway.json) and the platform rules every agent follows live in the core repository, `ultrastable/ultrastable` (`agents/AGENTS.md`, `instances/replication-ledger/`, `doctrine/tenant-repos.json`).

- Test: `node --test worker/*.test.mjs`. Validate the data: `node worker/cli.mjs validate`. Check every DOI at Crossref: `node worker/cli.mjs verify`.
- Add a replication: `node worker/cli.mjs add <finding> <doi> --kind K --outcome O [--prereg] --summary "..."`; the citation comes from Crossref by DOI and the standing change is logged.
- Honest standings: every standing is computed by `worker/standing.js`; never type one. Summaries carry no typed numbers.
- No accounts, no cookies. Nothing here holds a credential.

visitor_apps._doc: LAUNCH-PATH-1: an idea typed at ultrastable.io by someone with no code agent. Its launch record lives in the site's store (site/graduate.js); deploy/launch-apps.mjs (run daily by tenant-repos.yml) deploys its own system, creates its repository from the template, files the owner's requests there and invites the owner on request. Visitor apps have no folder under instances/: their manifest is generated from the idea.
